capabilities: Convert canvas text cards into notes named after their first line
Insert wikilinks from labeled arrows into the source note under an auto-generated section
Keep cards whose first line starts with a period pinned on the canvas instead of converting them
Sync note file names with later edits to the first line while preserving manual renames
Run processing on demand via hotkey, ribbon menu or command palette
extras: README is mostly in Persian with an English intro; includes a detailed version-by-version changelog and warns that optional background auto-processing previously caused canvas zoom/position resets and cursor jumps while typing.
intentEvidence: Automatically converts Obsidian Canvas text cards into notes (named after their first line)
problem: Obsidian Canvas text cards stay isolated from the vault and the labels on arrows between cards never appear as links inside any note, so canvas relationships are invisible to search, backlinks and the graph.
summary: Canvas helper that converts text cards into notes named after their first line and writes labeled arrow connections as wikilinks in the source note.
